visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long, straight light brown hair wearing a beige oversized jacket and blue jeans walks away from the camera in a brightly lit pharmacy aisle stocked with rows of skincare products. She turns her head and body toward the camera, holding a blue tube of sunscreen while smiling. (2) Close-up shot of several skincare boxes and tubes arranged on a flat surface: a pink Transino box, a yellow Melano CC tube, a green Care Cera bottle, and a blue Skin Aqua tube. (3) The woman is now in a different indoor setting with shelves behind her, speaking directly to the camera with expressive hand gestures. (4) She applies white foam from the yellow Melano CC tube to her face, rubbing it in circular motions; her skin appears wet and soapy. (5) In a close-up, she pumps white lotion from the green Care Cera bottle onto the back of her hand and then gently pats it onto her cheek. (6) She holds the blue Skin Aqua sunscreen bottle, showing its texture on her arm; the product is a clear, watery liquid. (7) She applies a pinkish balm stick from ettusais to her under-eye and nose area. (8) She holds a white and pink box of Transino EX tablets and points to her cheek. (9) She shows a gold-colored pouch of THE LYPO capsules, then opens it to reveal small beige capsules inside. (10) The screen splits into multiple frames showing her with various products, ending with her gesturing 'two' with her fingers while looking at the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy female voice speaks in Traditional Chinese with a bright, enthusiastic tone and moderate pitch. Upbeat electronic pop BGM with a steady 4/4 beat begins immediately. (2) A 'whoosh' sound effect marks a scene transition as the speaker introduces the products. The BGM remains consistent in the background. (3) Vocal energy remains high as the speaker describes Melano CC; the speech rate is fast but clear. (4) Distinct 'ding' sound effect coincides with text appearing on screen for the first product. Music continues with synth pads and a light percussive rhythm. (5) Another 'whoosh' SFX occurs during a quick cut to the next product (Care Cera). (6) A short 'click' SFX is heard as she opens the Skin Aqua container. BGM volume slightly ducks during key information points then swells back up. (7) Narration continues with high emotional valence and arousal. Occasional subtle 'pop' sounds for on-screen variety text emphasize product benefits. (8) Audio concludes with a final enthusiastic call to action; the BGM fades out quickly with a short 'stinger' effect.
